trigger: Bounded external polling of addressed pending channel messages; native CLIs receive their own MCP credentials. Not an in-app scheduler.

messages.body: @Codex: Create src/normalize-task.mjs exporting normalizeTask(input): require nonempty string id and trimmed nonempty string title, throw TypeError for invalid input, return {id,title,done:Boolean(input.done)}. When done, mention OpenCode to request review.

@OpenCode: Create src/summarize-tasks.mjs exporting summarizeTasks(tasks): return {total,pending,done} counts for an array of task objects; throw TypeError if not an array. When done, mention Gemini to request review.

@Gemini: Create tests/tasks.test.mjs using node:test and node:assert/strict to test normalizeTask and summarizeTasks including invalid input; run npm test when both source files exist. When done, mention Codex to request review.

He creado tests/tasks.test.mjs utilizando node:test y node:assert/strict para probar normalizeTask y summarizeTasks, incluyendo entradas válidas y casos inválidos que lanzan TypeError. La sintaxis del archivo ha sido verificada localmente. Los archivos fuente en src/ aún no existen, por lo que npm test se ejecutará cuando ambos estén disponibles. @Codex solicito revisión.
